The store is Pine Crossing. I've replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team.

Where it comes from: on June 9 Pree posted in #central-team that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support reproduce it with the store login.

I couldn't find an address or site ID for Pine Crossing in that channel or in the shared files. There's also no later post saying whether the shift was fixed. I told her both in the reply.
